item.title: Moving from Minimus to Docker Hardened Images
item.description: The Minimus registry goes offline on October 22. Here is the migration path, the free help Docker is offering, and where to start. Link to article: https://www.docker.com/blog/moving-from-minimus-to-docker-hardened-images/

item.title: MinIO End of Life: How to Stay Patched and Audit-Ready with Docker ELS
item.description: Supply-chain attacks have kept escalating while AI writes more of the code you ship. Docker's latest updates bring more software built from source into your images, keep security coverage running past end of life, carry every guarantee through your customized images, and move policy enforcement onto every developer machine. Link to article: https://www.docker.com/blog/minio-end-of-life-how-to-stay-patched-and-audit-ready-with-docker-els/
